findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess call with shell=True
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True can be dangerous if command strings are constructed from user input
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess or OS command execution call that may be vulnerable if user input is involved."
findings.hypothesis: Looking for subprocess calls with shell=True or os.system calls that could be vulnerable to command injection

message.text: Subprocess or OS command execution call that may be vulnerable if user input is involved.
